camel_example: aliyun ehpc ListNodes --region cn-hangzhou --Role Manager --HostNameSuffix 01 --PrivateIpAddress '172.16.00.00' --PageSize 10 --ClusterId 'ehpc-hz-FYUr320000' --PageNumber 1 --Filter '{"status":"running"}' --SortBy AddedTime --HostNamePrefix compute --Sequence Forward --HostName 'test-HostName'
description_en: Queries the list of nodes in a cluster
description_zh: 调用ListNodes查询指定集群中的节点列表
kebab_example: aliyun ehpc list-nodes --cluster-id ehpc-hz-FYUr320000 --role Manager --host-name test-HostName --page-number 1 --page-size 10 --sequence Forward --sort-by AddedTime --filter '{"status":"running"}' --private-ip-address 172.16.00.00 --host-name-prefix compute --host-name-suffix 01 --api-version 2018-04-12 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListNodes

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the cluster.

You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html operation to query the cluster ID
parameters.help_zh:
待查询的集群ID。

您可以通过调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/87116.html获取集群ID
parameters.name: cluster_id

parameters.help_en:
The type of the node. Valid values:

Manager: management node
Login: logon node
Compute: compute node
parameters.help_zh:
节点类型。取值范围：
Manager：管控节点
Login：登录节点
Compute：计算节点
parameters.name: role

parameters.help_en: The name of the node. You can perform a fuzzy search. MySQL regular expressions are supported
parameters.help_zh: 节点名称，支持模糊查询，支持MySQL的正则表达式
parameters.name: host_name

parameters.help_en: The number of the page to return. Pages start from page 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en:
The number of entries to return on each page. Valid values: 1 to 100.

Default value: 10
parameters.help_zh:
每页显示的条数。取值范围：1~100

默认值：10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en:
The sorting method of the node list. Valid values:

Forward: sorts the nodes in chronological order.
Backward: sorts the nodes in reverse chronological order.

Default value: Forward.

This parameter is used together with the SortBy parameter. If you set SortBy to AddedTime and set Sequence to Forward, nodes are queried in ascending order of time that they are added
parameters.help_zh:
节点列表排序方式。取值范围：
Forward：正序排序。
Backward：逆序排序。

默认值：Forward

和SortBy同时使用，如SortBy设置为AddedTime，Sequence设置为Forward，表示按节点加入时间正序查询
parameters.name: sequence

parameters.help_en:
The sorting method of the node list. Valid values:

AddedTime: sorts the nodes by the time that they are added.
HostName: sorts the nodes by their host names
parameters.help_zh:
节点列表排序方式。取值范围：
AddedTime：按加入时间排序

HostName：按节点主机名称排序
parameters.name: sort_by

parameters.help_en:
The filter options of the node list.

Format: {"status":"node_status"}. Replace node_status with the node status. Valid values of node_status:

uninit: The node is being installed.
exception: An exception occurred on the node.
running: The node is running.
initing: The node is being initialized.
releasing: The node is being released.
untracking: The node is not added to the cluster.
stopped: The node is stopped
parameters.help_zh:
节点状态过滤选项。

取值格式为：{"status":"node_status"}，请将其中node_status替换为节点的状态。节点的取值范围为：

uninit：安装中
exception：异常
running：运行中
initing：初始化中
releasing：释放中
untracking：未加入集群
stopped：已停止
parameters.name: filter

parameters.help_en: The private IP address of the node
parameters.name: private_ip_address

parameters.help_en: The prefix of the hostname. You can query nodes that have a specified prefix
parameters.help_zh: 主机名前缀。查询具有指定前缀的节点
parameters.name: host_name_prefix

parameters.help_en: The suffix of the hostname. You can query nodes that have a specified suffix
parameters.help_zh: 主机名后缀。查询具有指定后缀的节点
parameters.name: host_name_suffix

AddTime.description_en: The time when the node is added to the cluster

CreateMode.description_en:
The mode in which the compute nodes are added. Valid values:

manual: The node is manually added.
autoscale: The node is automatically added
CreateMode.description_zh:
节点创建方式。可能值：
manual：手动扩容
autoscale：自动扩容

CreatedByEhpc.description_en:
Indicates whether the node is created by using E-HPC.

true: The node is created by using E-HPC.
false: The node is not created by using E-HPC
CreatedByEhpc.description_zh:
是否由E-HPC创建。

true：E-HPC创建

false：非E-HPC创建

Expired.description_en: Indicates whether the subscription node expired. For a pay-as-you-go node, false is returned
Expired.description_zh: 包年包月付费节点是否到期。如果是按量付费节点，返回值为false

ExpiredTime.description_en: The time when the subscription node expires. For a pay-as-you-go node, a null value is returned
ExpiredTime.description_zh: 包年包月付费节点到期时间。如果是按量付费节点，返回值为空

HostName.description_en: The name of the task node

ImageId.description_en: The ID of the custom image

ImageOwnerAlias.description_en:
The type of the image. Valid values:

system: public image
self: custom image
others: shared image
marketplace: Alibaba Cloud Marketplace image
ImageOwnerAlias.description_zh:
镜像类型。可能值：
system：公共镜像
self：自定义镜像
others：共享镜像
marketplace：镜像市场镜像

InstanceType.description_en: The instance types of the node

IpAddress.description_en: The IP address of the node

Location.description_en:
The location where the node is deployed. Valid values:

OnPremise: The node is deployed on your data center.
PublicCloud: The node is deployed on the public cloud
Location.description_zh:
节点所在位置。可能值：
OnPremise：本地节点
PublicCloud：公共云节点

LockReason.description_en:
The reason why the node is locked. Valid values:

financial: The instance is locked due to overdue payments.
security: The node is locked for security reasons.
recycling: The preemptible instance is locked and pending release.
dedicatedhostfinancial: The ECS instance is locked due to overdue payments of the dedicated host.

By default, an empty string is returned
LockReason.description_zh:
节点被锁定类型。可能值：
financial：因欠费被锁定。
security：因安全原因被锁定。
recycling：抢占式实例的待释放锁定状态。
dedicatedhostfinancial：因为专有宿主机欠费导致ECS实例被锁定。

默认返回为空字符串

PublicIpAddress.description_en: The public IP address of the server

Role.description_en:
The type of the node. Valid values:

Scheduler: primary scheduling node
SchedulerBackup: secondary scheduling node
Account: primary domain server node
AccountBackup: secondary domain server node
Login: logon node
Compute: compute node

Scheduling nodes and domain server nodes are management nodes
Role.description_zh:
节点类别。可能值：
Scheduler：主调度器
SchedulerBackup：备用调度器
Account：主域服务器
AccountBackup：备用域服务器
Login：登录节点
Compute：计算节点

调度器和域服务器都属于管控节点

items.description_en:
The type of the node. Valid values:

Scheduler: primary scheduling node
SchedulerBackup: secondary scheduling node
Account: primary domain server node
AccountBackup: secondary domain server node
Login: logon node
Compute: compute node

Scheduling nodes and domain server nodes are management nodes
items.description_zh:
节点类别。可能值：
Scheduler：主调度器
SchedulerBackup：备用调度器
Account：主域服务器
AccountBackup：备用域服务器
Login：登录节点
Compute：计算节点

调度器和域服务器都属于管控节点

SpotStrategy.description_en: The bidding method of the compute nodes

StateInSched.description_en: The status of the node displayed on the scheduler. The status varies with the scheduler
StateInSched.description_zh: 从调度器查看到的节点状态，不同调度器状态不同

Status.description_en:
The status of the node. Valid values:

uninit: The node is being installed.
exception: An exception occurred on the node.
running: The node is running.
initing: The node is being initialized.
releasing: The node is being released.
untracking: The node is not added to the cluster.
stopped: The node is stopped
Status.description_zh:
节点状态。可能值：
uninit：安装中
exception：异常
running：运行中
initing：初始化中
releasing：释放中
untracking：未加入集群
stopped：已停止

TotalResources.description_en: The statistics of the resources used by the node
TotalResources.description_zh: 该节点使用的资源总量

UsedResources.description_en: The usage of the compute nodes in the cluster. For other types of nodes, an empty value is returned
UsedResources.description_zh: 计算节点资源使用量，其他类型节点返回值为空

Version.description_en: The version of the client that is used for the cluster

VpcId.description_en: The VPC ID of the node

PageSize.description_en: The number of entries returned per page

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of returned entries
